title: Finite-counit normalization data for a base-system trace
statement: Fix D,l,E,X,S,G,Q and the finite dualizing identifications eQ with eQ identifying each evaluated Q with the finite dualizing term [lem-coef-finite-dualizing]. Define the intrinsic finite counit by transporting the ordinary etale exceptional counit through the fixed dualizing origin and compact-support site comparison. A normalized trace consists of a natural support-functor comparison with native quotient-system compact support, finite identifications of the base tensor unit with A_n[0], and a map from support(Q) to that unit whose evaluations equal the specified finite counit word. Define the natural Hom comparison from this trace by [def-coef-system-exceptional-transpose]. No witness is chosen from an existence theorem.
